questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the fourth term in the same way as the first term is related to the second term and the fifth term is related to the sixth term.

512 ∶ 10 ∶∶ ? ∶ 11 ∶∶ 1331 : 13
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic:** Number³ : (Number + 2)

 
• 512 ∶ 10 → 8³ : (8 + 2)
 
• 1331 ∶ 13 → 113 : (11 + 2)

Similarly,

 
• ? : 11 → 93 : (9 + 2)

 
 
• → ? = 729
 
 

Hence, '**729**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

No ties are pants.

All pants are shirts.

All ties are shirts.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some shirts are ties.

II. Some shirts are pants.

III. Some ties are shirts.

options.text: Only conclusions I and III follow
Only conclusions II and III follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/57440c12c41dc0a1a0427b46e136663feefb6b6c0b0b3ae0cfd7db65804109f9.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some shirts are ties. → **Follows** (As, All ties are shirts)

II. Some shirts are pants. → Follows (As, All pants are shirts)

III. Some ties are shirts. → Follows (As, All ties are shirts)

Hence, '**All conclusions follow**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word.

(The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must not be related to each other based on the number of letters/number of consonants/vowels in the word)

Car : Seat belt :: Fan : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic:** Second word is a part of the first word.

Car : Seat belt → Car has seat belt.

Similarly,

Fan : ? → Fan has blades.

Hence, '**Blade**' is the correct answer.

questions.question: Seven friends M, N, O, P, Q, R and S are sitting on a straight bench facing towards east. P is sitting exactly at the middle position. Only four friends are sitting to the left of M. Only Q is sitting between R and S. O is sitting third to the right of S. Who is sitting at the second place from the right end?
questions.solution:
Seven friends **M, N, O, P, Q, R and S** are sitting on a straight bench facing towards east.

1. P is sitting exactly at the middle position.

2. Only four friends are sitting to the left of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/749acfeebbca5a55f6f6e69966629f94e57c49cf3954617b81a59ee0cb529590.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/04a8b70eacbcfbc40369628a100b3888fb2ea6f8f779c991c9902e02622135c8.png] 

3. Only Q is sitting between R and S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/37c7bf8430500776e72cb1b6f9fba80249b058cdac5c32c4f2e4c29238fef7da.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/09420a4a6c6db9bfdc00c81199c614d0faebfa2d4f686534b44bf19691008902.png] 

4. O is sitting third to the right of S.

The above condition can be satisfied only when R is sitting at the extreme end and S is sitting between Q and P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/86770be21af19e272704592be2b8a273efcbe0de91357c6f100925d82d65aeef.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/55dd3b05eadd4727eec3d6ed1f359c3a034132be1f3c39cf8614d47d44403d4e.png] 

Clearly, N the only person left will occupy the vacant position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dfdb46320e9208a666d053da27e7fd68d4325e22f4ca9f09ff7d1d49a2e1ee0c.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/10445c78e12f650fed635af8ece0cdc0e3956f14dcc6bb85ffd2373eac1b2bd2.png] 

Therefore, O is sitting at the second place from the right end.

Hence,** 'O' **is the correct answer.

‘A @ B’ means ‘B is the brother of A’

‘A $ B’ means ‘B is the husband of A’

If A $ B % C # D @ E, then how is E related to A?
questions.solution:

**Symbol**

sister
